title: Kneaded Brussels Sprout Delight
description: A salty and crisp vegetarian Egyptian dish featuring brussels sprouts that are kneaded for added texture and flavor.

ingredients.name: 1 cup Brussels sprouts, halved
ingredients.notes: Choose firm, immature sprouts with tight buds.

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add halved Brussels sprouts to the pan. Sprinkle with salt and toss gently until coated evenly.
Cook for about 5-7 minutes or until they start to brown slightly, occasionally stirring.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for another minute; be careful not to burn it.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over sprouts just before serving. Add chopped parsley on top.
